gloss: to be careless; to let one's guard down; to be off guard

definitions.gloss: to be careless; to let one's guard down
definitions.explanation: To become inattentive or complacent, lowering one's vigilance and leaving oneself vulnerable to mistakes or danger.

examples.japanese: {油断|ゆだん}しないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't let your guard down.

examples.japanese: {油断|ゆだん}して⟦いたら→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{財布|さいふ}→財布：00663_saifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{盗|ぬす}まれた→盗む：01166_nusumu⟧。
examples.english: I had my wallet stolen because I was off guard.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}っている→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧{油断|ゆだん}する⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{逆転|ぎゃくてん}→逆転：06839_gyakuten⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you're winning the match, if you let your guard down, you can get beaten by a comeback.

notes:
A culturally important concept in Japanese expressing the danger of complacency. The word carries a strong cautionary nuance — ⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧ almost always leads to negative consequences.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{油断|ゆだん}{大敵|たいてき}→油断大敵：05669_yudantaiteki⟧: complacency is the greatest enemy (proverb)
- ⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧⟦{禁物|きんもつ}→禁物：13738_kinmotsu⟧: carelessness is forbidden; must stay vigilant
- ⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: cannot be careless about; requiring constant vigilance
- ⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧: a moment's carelessness

ETYMOLOGY:
The kanji {油|ゆ} (oil) and {断|だん} (cut off) are said to derive from a Buddhist parable about carefully carrying a bowl of oil without spilling — any lapse in attention results in spillage.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something absent-mindedly — describes a momentary lapse rather than a sustained state of inattention
- ⟦{気|き}を{抜|ぬ}く→気を抜く：26974_kiwonuku⟧: to relax one's attention — similar meaning but less formal and without the strong cautionary overtone of ⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧
